newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE 226-3 VS BORDER, LEAD BY 260.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE 226-3 VS BORDER, LEAD BY 260.

text.p: Free State opener Deon Jordaan scored an unbeaten 103 to help his side to an overall lead of 260 on the third day of their Supersport series cricket match against Border at Springbok Park on Monday.

Border squandered the initiative in the match with a paltry gathering of just 56 runs in the morning session when they resumed at 321 for five but fast bowler Herman Bakkes was in inspired form with a career best six for 43.

The visitors eventually declared 34 runs in arrears of Free State's first innings total of 401 but by the close of play Jordaan's unbeaten 103 had helped the home side to 226 for three and an overall lead of 260.
Jordaan's patient century came from 196 deliveries and contained only five boundaries as he made doubly sure of adding to his list of five half-centuries in the competition this season.
The only misery for Free State came with the news that captain Louis Wilkinson's father had been killed in a car crash.
The United Cricket Board and Border captain Pieter Strydom took the unusual step of allowing twelfth man Morne van Wyk, a Grey Collge pupil, to replace Wilkinson in the team as a playing member.
